correctness.rationale: For connected windmill W_{n,m}=K1∨(n K_m), primitive period-two conservation implies each vertex fires once across two steps (constant firing totals 0 and 2 correspond fixed states), hence a unique representative phase with center firing. Reconstructed necessary and sufficient chip intervals d_v≤σ_v+q_v≤2d_v−1. A peripheral clique with k firers contributes binom(m,k)(m−k)^k(k+1)^(m−k) legal labelled assignments; a center-firing phase with K peripheral firers has exactly mn−K hub values, yielding H_{n,m}(z)=mn A_m(z)^n−z(A_m(z)^n)' and n(m−µ_m)α_m^n. The chip complement map σ↦2d−1−σ yields exact orbit-energy mean [(2m²+m)n−1]/2. Petal configurations under product law give iid X_i with mean µ, variance ν>0; uniform orbit law tilts by D_n=mn−∑X_i, and Cauchy–Schwarz gives total variation ≤sqrt(ν)/(2(m−µ)sqrt(n)). Hence Gaussian CLT for K, peripheral LLN energy, and independent asymptotically uniform hub chip interval yield the claimed joint independent Gaussian/Uniform limit. Independently implemented graph-step exhaustive enumeration for six (n,m) choices: (1,2) 6, (2,2) 60, (3,2) 450, (1,3) 60, (2,3) 4080, (1,4) 740 orbits; every K histogram and energy complement/mean identity matched. This finite test does not prove arbitrary n, m or the limit law. Assumptions m≥2, n≥1, labels fixed and primitive cycles only.
